spec_basis: STU-VID-023: 'Studio provides a SOURCE monitor showing a media item or a clip in isolation, and a PROGRAM monitor showing the sequence at the playhead. Both expose: transport (play, stop, step forward, step back, play in-to-out, loop), an in point and an out point'

STU-VID-024: 'An edit takes up to four points -- source in, source out, sequence in, sequence out -- and derives the missing one ... With four points where the durations disagree, Studio MUST offer an explicit fit choice'
